items.title: L3Harris (LHX) Lands Seven Year Missile Propulsion Deals For PAC 3 And THAAD
items.summary: L3Harris Technologies (NYSE:LHX) has signed multi year propulsion agreements with the Department of War and Lockheed Martin. The contracts cover missile propulsion production for the PAC 3 MSE and THAAD defense systems. The agreements are described as transformative and are intended to nearly triple and quadruple propulsion output for these programs. items.title: Lockheed Martin Gets a ‘Mega’ Missile Contract. War Spending Hasn’t Peaked.
items.summary: The U.S. has fired a lot of missiles lately, leaving the Defense Department motivated to quickly replace and grow its missile stocks.  “When you add the $54 billion dollars in this contract modification, you’re pushing $300 billion dollars of backlog for the company,” said CEO Jim Taiclet on Fox Business.  Lockheed is tripling production of its PAC-3 missiles.
